prompt:
Analyze this CAPA: NC Description: 'Incorrect torque values applied to wheel bolts on 23 vehicles during assembly on March 12. Torque wrench TW-009 found 15% out of calibration. Vehicles already shipped to dealers.' Determine root cause, immediate containment, corrective actions, and effectiveness verification plan.

Return a single JSON object with EXACTLY these fields:
- rootCause (string): identified root cause of the issue
- actions (string): corrective and preventive actions
- evidence (string): evidence required for verification

End your response with exactly one line: ANSWER: <your JSON object>
response: ANSWER: {"rootCause":"Torque wrench TW-009 was 15% out of calibration leading to incorrect torque values being applied to wheel bolts.","actions":"1. Recall all affected vehicles from dealers for re-torquing of wheel bolts. 2. Recalibrate torque wrench TW-009 and all other torque wrenches in use. 3. Implement a more frequent calibration schedule for all torque wrenches. 4. Train assembly line workers on the importance of torque specifications and calibration checks.","evidence":"1. Calibration reports for torque wrench TW-009 and other wrenches. 2. Records of re-torquing for all affected vehicles. 3. Training sign-off sheets for assembly line workers. 4. Updated calibration schedule documentation."}
